valid.name: the example workout, in the object form
the bare list of blocks, v left out
erg at 0 and at 300, a ramp to 300, cadence 40 and 150
a repeat of 2 and a repeat of 50
exactly 6 hours, with repeats counted out

invalid.name: a nested repeat
invalid.error: block 2, step 2: a repeat cannot sit inside another repeat. Write the rounds out or use one repeat.

invalid.name: an unknown key on a step
invalid.error: block 1: unknown key "speed". A step has label, dur_s, mode, optional cadence and its mode's target.

invalid.name: an unknown key on the object
invalid.error: steps: unknown key "title". Give {"v": 1, "steps": [...]} or just the list of blocks.

invalid.name: an unknown key on a repeat
invalid.error: block 2: unknown key "label". A repeat is {"repeat": 2 to 50, "steps": [...]} and has no other key.

invalid.name: pct 301
invalid.error: block 2, step 2: pct 301 is over 300.

invalid.name: pct_end 301
invalid.error: block 1: pct_end 301 is over 300.

invalid.name: pct -1
invalid.error: block 1: pct -1 is under 0.

invalid.name: pct 90.5
invalid.error: block 1: pct must be a whole number (got 90.5).

invalid.name: pct as text
invalid.error: block 1: pct must be a number, a whole one (got "90").

invalid.name: an erg step with no pct
invalid.error: block 1: an erg step needs pct, the % of FTP.

invalid.name: grade 4.55
invalid.error: block 1: grade must have at most one decimal (got 4.55).

invalid.name: grade 20.1
invalid.error: block 1: grade 20.1 is over 20.

invalid.name: grade -10.5
invalid.error: block 1: grade -10.5 is under -10.

invalid.name: a slope step carrying pct
invalid.error: block 2: pct is not a target in slope mode; slope mode takes grade.

invalid.name: an erg step carrying level
invalid.error: block 1: level is not a target in erg mode; erg mode takes pct and pct_end.

invalid.name: a free step carrying pct
invalid.error: block 1: pct is not a target in free mode; free mode takes no target.

invalid.name: level 101
invalid.error: block 1: level 101 is over 100.

invalid.name: an unknown mode
invalid.error: block 1: mode must be one of erg, resistance, slope, free (got "power").

invalid.name: a repeat of 1
invalid.error: block 1: repeat 1 is under 2.

invalid.name: a repeat of 51
invalid.error: block 1: repeat 51 is over 50.

invalid.name: a repeat with no steps
invalid.error: block 1: a repeat's steps are a list of 1 to 20 steps.

invalid.name: a repeat of 21 steps
invalid.error: block 1: a repeat's steps are a list of 1 to 20 steps.

invalid.name: a label of 41 characters
invalid.error: block 1: label is 41 characters, over 40.

invalid.name: a blank label
invalid.error: block 1: label must be 1 to 40 characters and not blank.

invalid.name: no label
invalid.error: block 1: label must be 1 to 40 characters and not blank.
